source.quote:
If the fallback fails to start or exits unsuccessfully, Kache warns and retries once
with the direct compiler.

contracts.obligation: Ordinary wrapper failure or missing fallback must preserve successful direct compiler behavior.
contracts.scope_limit: Simple Rust bin passthrough forced by cache_executables=0.

source.quote: Interrupts and termination requests (including shell statuses 130 and 143) do not trigger a retry.

contracts.obligation: Cancellation must propagate without creating direct compiler output.
contracts.scope_limit: Shell-forwarded statuses 130/143, not live signal-race sampling.

source.quote: This keeps the wrapper in place but passes compiler work through.

contracts.obligation: KACHE_DISABLED=1 must directly compile and skip configured fallback.
contracts.scope_limit: Single Rust compiler invocation; installer configuration belongs to CLI owner.

source.quote: Local-only caching works with no daemon.

contracts.obligation: An unavailable isolated daemon must not prevent local restore and compile.
contracts.scope_limit: No remote configured; no live-daemon crash timing.

source.quote: Two cargo processes that miss the same crate still share one real compile when the first stores an entry the second can restore.

contracts.obligation: Matching concurrent misses should avoid duplicate successful compilation.
contracts.scope_limit: No concurrency proof claimed by this secondary sweep.
